nodes.title: Place the beaker
nodes.description: Place the clean 250 mL beaker on the bench.

feedback.retry: Review Place the beaker and try again.

nodes.title: Pour in the sample
nodes.description: Pour the measured sample from the graduated cylinder into the beaker, then hold the cylinder upside down over the beaker for a few seconds so it drains.

feedback.retry: Review Pour in the sample and try again.

nodes.title: Rinse the cylinder
nodes.description: Rinse the inside of the cylinder into the beaker with three small squirts from the wash bottle, so the sample left on its walls goes in too.

feedback.retry: Review Rinse the cylinder and try again.

nodes.title: Record the observation
nodes.description: Record what you see in the beaker.

feedback.retry: Review Record the observation and try again.
